page.overview:
Who is Pappag?

Pappag is a starfish who is Camie's pet and teacher. He is the creator of the Criminal fashion line and is mentoring Camie to be a fashion designer.

He is an orange starfish that appears to be stitched along his outline. His face is in the middle of his body and he wears a hat similar to a or .

He is depicted in the game One Piece: Ocean's Dream! with the wrong color scheme on his hat.

After the two-year timeskip, Pappag wears sunglasses with the Criminal brand logo on the rims and has a small bow tie.
